HowItWorks.title: How the room works
HowItWorks.description: From the audit to your gallery: everything that happens to a work on ArtAuction.

audit.title: Authenticity audit
audit.p1: Every published work goes through an audit: rules that catch anachronisms (for example, acrylic before 1950) or repeated images, and a model that assesses the whole sheet.
audit.p2: If everything fits, the work is published with an authenticity score and a suggested price. If something does not fit, it goes to manual review and a person decides.

rooms.title: Auction rooms
rooms.p1: There are always some rooms open or about to open: every few minutes a catalog work goes up for auction and the room lasts between 15 and 30 minutes.
rooms.p2: The price only goes up. If someone bids in the last 30 seconds, the closing extends another 30. You can withdraw your bid up to 4 minutes before closing.
rooms.p3: The countdown uses the server's clock, so everyone sees the same time.

wallet.title: Artacoins and wallet
wallet.p1: Bids are paid in artacoins. You top them up in your wallet with a simulated charge: any card that has not expired works.
wallet.p2: When you bid, only the difference from your previous bid is held. If you lose, the hold comes back; if you win, it is charged, and the seller gets the price minus a 10% fee.

gallery.title: Your 3D gallery
gallery.p1: The works you win hang in your 3D room. You can walk through it, get close to each work and arrange it as you like: walls, floor, light and the position of each piece.
gallery.p2: Public works also appear in your public gallery, and other people can follow you.

model.title: 3D model
model.help: Required for sculptures and objects: the 3D room shows them with their real volume and at the height you declared. A .glb or .gltf works (Blender: File › Export › glTF 2.0), as does a .fbx or .obj, like those from Sketchfab or the Unity Asset Store. If the .obj or .gltf comes with separate materials (.mtl), buffers (.bin) or textures, choose them all at once. A .blend does not open on the web: export it. Between {min} and {max} triangles and up to 30 MB.
model.skipped: Without {files}: the browser cannot read that texture format. If the piece looks colorless or flat, export it with .png or .jpg textures.
